description: Somos Error 404, un equipo apasionado por la tecnología, la programación y la innovación. Elegimos el desafío "Construye un entrenador de misiones para astronautas junior" porque queremos desarrollar una experiencia interactiva y educativa que acerque a niños y jóvenes a la exploración espacial. Contamos con habilidades en desarrollo de software, diseño e inteligencia artificial. Nuestro objetivo es combinar creatividad, tecnología y trabajo en equipo para crear una solución innovadora.
summary:
We developed  Marts Rangers, an educational and interactive web-based video game that allows children ages 9 to 13 to experience the challenges of exploring and surviving on Mars. Players take on the role of commanders of a space base located in Jezero Crater, where they must keep a crew alive for seven Martian days.

Through an explorable 3D environment, players manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, energy, and food; face unexpected events; complete scientific missions; and participate in mini-games. Every decision has consequences that affect the base’s operations and the astronauts’ well-being.

The project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by transforming scientific knowledge and space exploration technologies into hands-on learning experiences. It incorporates educational references from NASA research and a virtual assistant named NOVA, who offers recommendations to help players make better decisions.

Our goal is to spark scientific curiosity, foster critical thinking, and demonstrate that learning about space can be a fun, interactive, and inspiring adventure for future generations.
